title: Can AI Agents Interface Clinicians and Complex Models?
title_zh: AI智能体能成为临床医生与复杂模型之间的接口吗？

paragraphs.en: Background : Contemporary healthcare institutions generate daily very large amounts of data, which contain highly useful information for the improvement of work organization, planning and overall efficiency. While models and techniques to extract these insights are well known and constantly developed in mathematical biology, complex systems physics and data science, the adoption of these techniques among Clinicians and Hospital Administrators remains limited, mainly due to language and methodological divides.
paragraphs.zh: 背景：当代医疗机构每天产生海量数据，其中包含对改进工作组织、规划和整体效率极为有用的信息。 尽管用于提取这些洞见的模型与方法在数学生物学、复杂系统物理学和数据科学领域已广为人知并不断发展，但临床医生和医院管理者对这些技术的采用仍然有限，主要原因是语言和方法论上的隔阂。

paragraphs.en: Objective : In this article we implement an AI Multi Agent System (MAS) that allows Users to use predictive models and make statistical analyses via natural language conversations.
paragraphs.zh: 目标：在本文中，我们实现了一个 AI 多智能体系统（MAS），允许用户通过自然语言对话使用预测模型并进行统计分析。

paragraphs.en: Methods : We developed EpidemIA, a training-free MAS endowed with a modular suite of epidemiological models written by human experts, executable on a single-GPU workstation. To avoid relaying sensitive data to third parties, the system uses locally an open-weights LLM as backbone for its two subagents.
paragraphs.zh: 方法：我们开发了 EpidemIA，一个免训练的多智能体系统（MAS），配备一套由人类专家编写的模块化流行病学模型套件，可在单 GPU 工作站上运行。 为避免将敏感数据转发给第三方，该系统在本地使用一个开放权重大语言模型（LLM）作为其两个子智能体的骨干。

paragraphs.en: Results : Using a dataset of Emergency Department visits provided to us by IRCCS Sant’Orsola (Bologna) we test the model on a few typical use cases, demonstrating the possibility of performing both simpler statistical analyses and visualizations as well as more complicated epidemiological predictions based on dynamical models, through simple queries made in natural language.
paragraphs.zh: 结果：使用IRCCS Sant'Orsola（博洛尼亚）提供的一份急诊科就诊数据集，我们在几个典型的用例上对该模型进行了测试，证明了通过简单的自然语言查询，既可以执行较简单的统计分析和可视化，也可以进行基于动力学模型的更复杂的流行病学预测。

paragraphs.en: Conclusions : While still being a proof-of-concept implementation, EpidemIA showcases the transformative capabilities of LLM based technologies as an enabling factor in the widespread adoption of complex dynamical models, which is at present hindered by their steep learning curve.
paragraphs.zh: 结论：尽管仍处于概念验证实现阶段，EpidemIA 展示了基于大语言模型（LLM）的技术作为推动复杂动力学模型广泛采用的赋能因素所具有的变革能力，而目前这种采用正因模型陡峭的学习曲线而受阻。

paragraphs.en: Contemporary healthcare institutions and hospitals generate massive, rapidly growing volumes of data [ 1 ] , spanning across multiple scales and modalities. At the single-patient scale, common information sources include imaging diagnostics, biomedical laboratory results, and wearable sensors. Broadening the scope, organization-wide data capture facility operations, such as Emergency Department visits, ward bed occupancy, or procedure scheduling. At an even larger scale, population-level records track metrics like vaccine coverage statistics or the prevalence of chronic conditions. Extracting relevant information from these datasets has long been the primary focus of biomedical statistics, establishing standard methodologies in medical practice and research [ 2 ] . More recently, the big data paradigm has accelerated the adoption of data science and machine learning (ML) techniques, finding in biomedicine one of their most fertile domains [ 3 , 4 , 5 ] . A central open challenge remains the fruitful integration of heterogeneous sources, merging clinical records with external inputs like weather observations or mobility data. Furthermore, to tangibly benefit healthcare systems, analytical approaches must extend beyond retrospective description toward prospective scenario forecasting, allowing clinicians and decision-makers to evaluate treatment options, operational strategies, or containment measures.
paragraphs.zh: 当今的医疗机构和医院产生海量且快速增长的数据 [ 1 ] ，涵盖多种尺度与模态。 在单个患者的尺度上，常见的信息来源包括影像诊断、生物医学实验室结果以及可穿戴传感器。 将范围扩大，机构级的数据采集涵盖医院运营事务，例如急诊科就诊、病房床位占用率或手术排程。 在更大的尺度上，人群层面的记录则跟踪诸如疫苗接种覆盖率统计或慢性病患病率等指标。 从这些数据集中提取相关信息长期以来一直是生物医学统计的主要关注点，并在医疗实践与研究中确立了标准方法论 [ 2 ] 。 近年来，大数据范式加速了数据科学与机器学习（ML）技术的应用，而生物医学正是其最富成果的领域之一 [ 3 , 4 , 5 ] 。 一个核心的开放性挑战仍然是如何有效整合异构数据源，将临床记录与天气观测或流动性数据等外部输入相融合。 此外，为了切实惠及医疗系统，分析方法必须超越回顾性描述，迈向前瞻性的情景预测，使临床医生和决策者能够评估治疗方案、运营策略或防控措施。

paragraphs.en: While purely data-oriented systems are still developing these predictive capabilities, dynamical models incorporate them by construction, making a synergistic integration of both approaches highly promising. A paradigmatic example lies in epidemiological models, which capture pathogen transmission across a population. The foundational compartmental framework introduced in [ 6 ] models transitions between disease stages, capturing the infection course in a simplified mathematical manner. While this classic formulation can interpolate incidence curves to estimate infection and recovery rates, numerous extensions have been developed to address richer multimodal dynamics. Notable examples include models for vector-borne diseases such as Malaria [ 7 ] or Dengue [ 8 ] , models incorporating human mobility data [ 9 , 10 , 11 ] , and formulations accounting for distributed stage durations with explicit delays [ 12 , 13 , 14 , 15 ] . The common strength of these models is their mechanistic portrayal of the interplay between epidemiological processes and socio-environmental factors, making them inherently suited for scenario simulation.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管纯数据驱动的系统仍在发展这些预测能力，动力学模型则通过其构造方式天然具备这些能力，因此两种方法的协同整合极具前景。 一个典型的例子是流行病学模型，它刻画病原体在人群中的传播。 [ 6 ] 中提出的基础分区框架对疾病各阶段之间的转换进行建模，以简化的数学方式刻画感染进程。 虽然这一经典形式可以通过对发病率曲线进行插值来估计感染率和康复率，但为了应对更丰富的多模态动力学，研究者已开发出大量扩展模型。 著名的例子包括针对疟疾 [ 7 ] 或登革热 [ 8 ] 等虫媒疾病的模型、纳入人口流动数据的模型 [ 9 , 10 , 11 ] ，以及通过显式延迟刻画分布式阶段时长的模型 [ 12 , 13 , 14 , 15 ] 。 这些模型的共同优势在于它们对流行病学过程与社会环境因素之间相互作用的机制性刻画，使其天然适用于情景模拟。

paragraphs.en: Despite their great potential, both purely data-oriented and dynamical modelling approaches must overcome a fundamental challenge before they can deliver their full positive impact on healthcare organizations: the methodological divide between medically-trained personnel and decision makers, the end users of models, and the community of physicists, mathematicians and computer scientists that typically develop them [ 16 , 17 , 18 ] . Indeed, the mentioned models are developed and well understood in the fields of Complex Systems Physics and Mathematical Biology, using concepts from these disciplines, which present a steep learning curve for clinicians or decision-makers, as these are not the main focus during their training [ 16 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 尽管纯数据驱动和动力学建模方法都具有巨大潜力，但在它们能够对医疗机构发挥全部积极作用之前，必须克服一个根本性挑战：受过医学训练的人员与决策者（即模型的最终使用者）以及通常负责开发这些模型的物理学、数学和计算机科学界之间存在方法论鸿沟 [ 16 , 17 , 18 ] 。 事实上，上述模型是在复杂系统物理学和数学生物学领域内、运用这些学科的概念开发和深入理解的，而临床医生或决策者在培训期间并不以这些内容为主要学习方向，因此这些概念对他们而言学习门槛很高 [ 16 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Among the many Artificial Intelligence (AI) types developed recently, Large Language Models (LLMs) such as Generative Pre-trained Transformers [ 19 ] , i.e. conversational chatbots based on transformer neural networks, have proved to be among the most intuitive in terms of user experience [ 20 , 21 , 22 ] . While the token-by-token prediction working principle behind LLMs is successful in Natural Language Processing (NLP), it lacks the structure to perform both numerical or analytical mathematical tasks [ 23 , 24 , 25 ] , so that a direct usage in data analysis is not advisable. Similarly, whenever asked to make predictions with a model such as epidemiological ones, an LLM would purely rely on its ability to predict tokens. In addition, interaction with a plain LLM is only possible through prompting, i.e. LLMs by themselves cannot process external files unless when they are fed them directly.
paragraphs.zh: 在近期开发的众多人工智能（AI）类型中，以生成式预训练变换器[19]为代表的大语言模型（LLM），即基于变换器神经网络的对话式聊天机器人，已在用户体验方面被证明是最为直观易用的模型之一[20,21,22]。 虽然大语言模型所基于的逐词元预测工作原理在自然语言处理（NLP）中取得了成功，但它缺乏执行数值或解析性数学任务所需的结构[23,24,25]，因此直接将其用于数据分析并不可取。 类似地，每当被要求使用某个模型（如流行病学模型）进行预测时，大语言模型只会纯粹依赖其预测词元的能力。 此外，与纯大语言模型的交互只能通过提示（prompting）进行，即 大语言模型本身无法处理外部文件，除非这些文件被直接输入给它。

paragraphs.en: Recent efforts to make up for the shortcomings of LLMs, have seen the rise of the AI agent paradigm [ 26 , 27 , 28 , 29 ] . An AI agent is an LLM with reasoning capabilities [ 30 , 31 ] , referred to as the agent backbone , endowed with the ability to make calls to external programs, called tools , which can perform tasks outside the backbone’s text-based interaction model [ 32 , 33 ] . A tool can be any external component that performs complex tasks, possibly depending on parameters generated by the LLM backbone. Some common tools, for example, allow the execution of backbone-written code, searching the internet or interacting with a filesystem [ 29 ] . In this context the reasoning workflow is straightforwardly extended to tool use, as the agent can alternate reasoning sessions and tool calls many times, especially for complex tasks that require more than a single tool [ 34 , 33 ] , to improve the response quality before presenting it to the user, iterating in a loop. See Fig. 1 for a visual representation of an agentic loop. Finally, to improve their performance, agents are generally endowed with a context window, i.e. a log of recent information, conversational history and tool responses.
paragraphs.zh: 为弥补大语言模型（LLM）的不足，近期涌现出人工智能智能体范式 [ 26 , 27 , 28 , 29 ] 。 人工智能智能体是具备推理能力的大语言模型 [ 30 , 31 ] ，被称为智能体骨干，并被赋予调用外部程序的能力，这些外部程序称为工具，可以执行骨干基于文本的交互模型之外的任务 [ 32 , 33 ] 。 工具可以是任何执行复杂任务的外部组件，其可能依赖于由大语言模型骨干生成的参数。 例如，一些常见的工具允许执行骨干编写的代码、搜索互联网或与文件系统交互 [ 29 ] 。 在这种背景下，推理工作流被直接扩展到工具使用，智能体可以多次交替进行推理会话和工具调用，尤其是对于需要不止一个工具的复杂任务 [ 34 , 33 ] ，以便在向用户呈现回复之前通过循环迭代来提高回复质量。 智能体循环的可视化表示见图 1。 最后，为了提高性能，智能体通常配备上下文窗口，即最近信息、对话历史和工具响应的记录。

paragraphs.en: To further improve on the capabilities of single agents in handling articulate tasks, Multi-Agent AI Systems (MAS) [ 35 , 36 ] have emerged as the leading framework. A MAS is a set of AI agents that continuously process inputs while interacting across a dynamic communication graph [ 35 , 37 ] and sharing common information, referred to as state . Within this setup, each node of the graph is an agent with a specialized role, negotiating intermediate outputs to achieve a collective goal. MAS achieve superior performance over single agents when tasks allow flexible division and reallocation driven by real time feedback [ 37 , 38 ] , and have rapidly gained attention also thanks to the supervisor orchestration architecture. Modelled after the structure of a research team, this architecture features a primary supervisor agent responsible for task delegation, while specialized expert agents focus on deep reasoning and execution within their respective domains [ 39 ] . Upon receiving a task, the supervisor decomposes it into sub tasks, assigning them to the appropriate expert agents, and aggregates the resulting outputs [ 40 ] .

paragraphs.en: MASs have already seen some applications in the healthcare field, with their most common uses in systems working at the single-patient scale. Some examples are the analysis of medical records and wearable data, and their integration with context information to feed coaching systems that guide users with suggestions and track their progress [ 41 ] , general-purpose question answering [ 42 ] and the design of pharmacological treatment posology plans [ 43 , 44 ] . In the public health and epidemiological setting, most efforts have focused on determining the impact of LLM-powered systems as tools to organize data for tasks such as data management, assessment of antibiotic resistance and surveillance of variants of concern [ 45 , 46 ] . The usage of LLM-based systems as simple interfaces for epidemiological models, on the contrary, has seen limited study, mainly introducing them as high-level interpreters between users and pre-built simulation frameworks [ 47 ] , in order to broaden their usage and comprehension across the medical community, but without integrating them with clinical dataset access and data-informed forecasting capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 多智能体系统（MAS）在医疗健康领域已有一些应用，其最常见的用途是在单患者规模的系统中工作。 一些例子包括对医疗记录和可穿戴设备数据的分析，并将其与情境信息整合，为辅导系统提供输入，以向用户提供建议并跟踪其进展[41]、通用问答[42]，以及药物治疗方案设计[43, 44]。 在公共卫生和流行病学领域，大多数工作集中在评估基于LLM的系统作为工具在数据管理等任务中的影响，例如数据管理、抗生素耐药性评估和关切变异株监测[45, 46]。 相反，将基于LLM的系统用作流行病学模型的简单接口的研究较少，主要是将其作为用户与预构建仿真框架之间的高级解释器引入[47]，以拓宽医学界对其的使用和理解，但并未将其与临床数据集访问及数据驱动的预测能力相整合。

paragraphs.en: In this article, we leverage the intuitiveness and simplicity of LLMs interaction to make complex predictive models and data science insight more accessible to clinicians and decision-makers. The information and answers that these professionals seek from data in their day-to-day tasks often include a variable and flexibly defined succession of simpler tasks. For example a head physician, observing an increased workload in their ward, could at first be interested in the time series of accesses for a given condition in the near past, but to get a clearer idea they might subsequently want to compare it to the accesses for a different time period or pathology. Similarly, an operational researcher might want to look at the trend of new flu cases and make a projection for the future in order to plan supply schedules and personnel work shifts accordingly, comparing scenarios with different vaccination coverages. Each of these example tasks requires several operatively diverse steps, encompassing data analysis, simulation, visualization and reporting, which may need reiteration and reorganization at runtime depending on the user queries. Breaking down a broadly defined natural language query into smaller specialized actions is the ideal use case for MASs, which we adopt as design in our system for this specific reason.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们利用大语言模型（LLMs）交互的直观性和简洁性，使临床医生和决策者更容易获得复杂的预测模型和数据科学洞察。 这些专业人士在日常任务中从数据中寻求的信息和答案，通常包含一系列可变且灵活定义的较简单任务的连续执行。 例如，一位观察到所在病房工作量增加的主治医生，起初可能想了解近期某特定病症的就诊时间序列，但为了获得更清晰的认识，他们随后可能想将其与不同时间段或不同病症的就诊情况进行比较。 同样，运筹学研究人员可能想查看新增流感病例的趋势并对未来进行预测，以便相应地规划物资供应时间表和人员轮班，并比较不同疫苗接种覆盖率的情景。 上述每个示例任务都需要多个操作上各异的步骤，涵盖数据分析、模拟、可视化和报告，这些步骤可能需要根据用户查询在运行时进行迭代和重组。 将宽泛定义的自然语言查询分解为更小的专门化操作，正是多智能体系统（MASs）的理想使用场景，正是出于这一特定原因，我们在系统中采用了这种设计。

paragraphs.en: Agents and MASs have proved to be sufficiently capable in writing and executing custom code for basic data science tasks and visualizations [ 48 , 49 ] , capitalizing solely on the coding knowledge extracted from their training data. The usage of dynamical predictive models, on the other hand, is a significantly more complicated task, as it requires a combination of coding ability, rigorous data processing and a dexterity with the analytical aspects of Mathematical Biology and the simplifications made when formulating models. At present, this type of task can be challenging for open source LLMs, while usage of proprietary, closed source, LLM backbones presents alarming sensitive data and general privacy implications. Most importantly, though, while greedy decoding ( T = 0 T=0 ) theoretically ensures deterministic LLM outputs, empirical and system-level studies show that run-to-run non-determinism persists in modern inference engines due to the interplay of floating-point non-associativity and the lack of batch invariance under dynamic request batching, so that repetition of the same query could lead to different results [ 50 , 51 ] . This has relevant implications for dynamical predictive modelling, as identical repeated queries could provide different implementations of a single model differing in substantial details, and thus requiring separate validations. Finally, hallucinations [ 52 , 53 ] might sometimes produce entirely unreliable answers. While these behaviours may be acceptable in general-purpose applications they ought to be mitigated in sensitive contexts such as healthcare organizations.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体与多智能体系统已被证明足以胜任编写和执行基本数据科学任务与可视化的自定义代码[48, 49]，其能力完全来源于从训练数据中提取的编程知识。 另一方面，使用动态预测模型则是一项复杂得多的任务，因为它需要结合编程能力、严谨的数据处理，以及对数学生物学分析方面的熟练掌握和在建模时所做出的简化。 目前，这类任务对开源大语言模型而言仍具挑战性，而使用专有的闭源大语言模型底座则带来令人担忧的敏感数据和整体隐私问题。 然而，最重要的是，尽管贪婪解码（T=0）在理论上能确保大语言模型输出的确定性，但实证和系统层面研究表明，由于浮点运算的非结合性与动态请求批处理下缺乏批不变性之间的相互作用，现代推理引擎中运行间的不确定性依然存在，因此重复同一查询可能导致不同的结果[50, 51]。 这对动态预测建模具有重要意义，因为相同的重复查询可能给出同一模型在实质细节上有所不同的不同实现，从而需要分别进行验证。 最后，幻觉[52, 53]有时可能产生完全不可靠的答案。 虽然这些行为在通用应用中或许可以接受，但在医疗保健机构等敏感环境中应当加以缓解。

paragraphs.en: In order to bridge the methodological barrier that pushes healthcare and organizational professionals away from broader usage of predictive models and data science techniques, we propose a conversational MAS architecture endowed with predictive modelling tools. Our system, which we name EpidemIA since it is focused on epidemiological modelling, is a training-free framework made up of two LLM-based sub-agents, which can exchange text messages, update a shared, system-wide state and interact with the underlying file system, e.g. to save intermediate results, visualizations or search for data sources.
paragraphs.zh: 为了弥合方法论上的障碍——正是这种障碍使医疗和组织的专业人员无法更广泛地使用预测模型与数据科学技术——我们提出一种配备了预测建模工具的对话式多智能体系统（MAS）架构。 我们的系统命名为 EpidemIA，因为它专注于流行病学建模；它是一个无需训练的框架，由两个基于大语言模型（LLM）的子智能体组成，这些智能体可以交换文本消息、更新共享的系统级状态，并与底层文件系统交互，例如保存中间结果、可视化，或搜索数据源。

paragraphs.en: The sub-agent handling user interaction is called Supervisor, and its main task is facilitating communication between human users and the sub-agent in charge of model usage and data processing, called the Analyst. The Analyst receives user prompts only through the Supervisor, which is tasked with reformulating them in clear statements. This task preprocessing strategy allows to mitigate the impact of unclear prompts on the quality of the Analyst’s work, by delegating as much of the interpretation effort as possible to the Supervisor.
paragraphs.zh: 负责用户交互的子智能体称为 Supervisor，其主要任务是促进人类用户与负责模型使用和数据处理的子智能体之间的沟通，后者称为 Analyst。 Analyst 仅通过 Supervisor 接收用户提示，Supervisor 的职责是将这些提示重新表述为清晰的陈述。 这一任务预处理策略通过将尽可能多的解释工作委派给 Supervisor，从而减轻不清晰提示对 Analyst 工作质量的影响。

paragraphs.en: The Analyst’s work is mainly achieved through coordinated calls to its tools, described in finer detail in Section 2.1 , which endow it with capabilities ranging from more general ones, such as code execution, to more field-specific ones. Within the second category fall tools that allow access to the datasets, making simulations, fitting models to observed time series and introspection over the available predictive models. The key feature of our system from this point of view is that the code used for statistical data analysis is autonomously written by the Analyst, but the predictive models, the metrics and procedures used for fitting are entirely written by human experts, in order to guarantee their validity and reliability. In order to be easily expandable and modifiable as the operative needs change and new models are developed, both models and metrics are organized in a modular structure, where new ones can be added simply by adding their implementations, which must obey a specific structure, in specific folders of the working file system. This is possible thanks to a dynamical import structure that allows the agent to discover the available models, together with some information about them at startup.

paragraphs.en: The proposed framework relies on a hierarchical multi-agent architecture designed to decouple conversational query resolution, task decomposition, and specialized computational workflows. At the top of this execution hierarchy operates the Supervisor agent, which acts as the primary conversational interface between the external User and the underlying execution layers. Acting as a stateful orchestrator, the Supervisor interfaces the User, directly answers simple questions, and mediates the delegation of data analysis requests to the Analyst sub agent, while deliberately abstaining from executing computational routines itself.
paragraphs.zh: 所提出的框架依赖于一种分层的多智能体架构，旨在将对话式查询解析、任务分解和专业化计算工作流解耦。 在该执行层级的顶端运行着 Supervisor 智能体，它充当外部用户与底层执行层之间的主要对话接口。 作为有状态的编排器，Supervisor 智能体与用户对接，直接回答简单问题，并协调将数据分析请求委派给 Analyst 子智能体，同时刻意避免亲自执行计算例程。

sents.en: The proposed framework relies on a hierarchical multi-agent architecture designed to decouple conversational query resolution, task decomposition, and specialized computational workflows.
sents.zh: 所提出的框架依赖于一种分层的多智能体架构，旨在将对话式查询解析、任务分解和专业化计算工作流解耦。

sents.en: At the top of this execution hierarchy operates the Supervisor agent, which acts as the primary conversational interface between the external User and the underlying execution layers.
sents.zh: 在该执行层级的顶端运行着 Supervisor 智能体，它充当外部用户与底层执行层之间的主要对话接口。

paragraphs.en: The Supervisor is explicitly restricted from accessing raw datasets stored within the data directory. It possesses no tools for data analysis, model fitting, or statistical inference. This constraint preserves the specialization of the sub-agents and minimizes the risk of generating hallucinated empirical conclusions during orchestration.
paragraphs.zh: 明确限制监督者访问存储在数据目录中的原始数据集。 它不具备任何用于数据分析、模型拟合或统计推断的工具。 这一约束保持了子智能体的专业化分工，并降低了在编排过程中产生幻觉性实证结论的风险。

paragraphs.en: The Supervisor has read only access to the models directory. This allows it to independently resolve non computational requests made by the User, such as clarifications about model parameters or structural assumptions of epidemiological modelling.
paragraphs.zh: 监督者对模型目录拥有只读访问权限。 这使其能够独立处理用户提出的非计算类请求，例如关于模型参数或流行病学建模的结构性假设的澄清。

paragraphs.en: When an incoming prompt concerns only theoretical concepts, mathematical definitions, or the structural properties of implemented models, the Supervisor resolves the request autonomously, formulating comprehensive explanations without routing control to the Analyst.
paragraphs.zh: 当传入的提示词仅涉及理论概念、数学定义或已实现模型的结构属性时，监督者会自主解决该请求，给出全面的解释，而不会将控制权路由给分析者。

paragraphs.en: Whenever a request demands data processing, parameter estimation, or epidemiological forecasting, the Supervisor delegates the task to the Analyst. It enhances the User input, eliminating conversational ambiguities and structuring the query into explicit analytical directives. If the User omits the specific model required for the prediction, the Supervisor resolves by completing the prompt with a Susceptible-Infectious-Recovered (SIR) model by default, ensuring workflow continuity without introducing redundant clarification turns.
paragraphs.zh: 每当请求需要数据处理、参数估计或流行病学预测时，监督者就会将该任务委派给分析智能体。 它对用户输入进行增强，消除对话中的歧义，并将查询结构化为明确的分析指令。 如果用户未指明预测所需的具体模型，监督者会通过默认在提示词中补充易感-感染-康复（SIR）模型来解决，从而确保工作流的连续性，而不会引入多余的澄清轮次。

paragraphs.en: After delegating a task, the Supervisor enters a monitoring state, waiting for the Analyst to report back its results. It cannot evaluate them but only aggregate the raw analytical findings and quantitative metrics, and construct a coherent narrative describing the methodological steps taken, delivering a structured summary back to the User. If the Analyst’s output reveals a misinterpretation of the User request, the Supervisor can resubmit the query pointing out the issue.
paragraphs.zh: 在委派任务之后，监督者进入监控状态，等待分析师汇报其结果。 它无法评估这些结果，只能汇总原始的分析发现和量化指标，并构建一段连贯的叙述来描述所采用的方法步骤，向用户交付一份结构化的摘要。 如果分析师的输出显示出对用户请求的误解，监督者可以重新提交查询并指出问题所在。

paragraphs.zh: 在编排层操作分析员子智能体之后，也就是该框架的计算核心，它专门负责数据分析和流行病学预测，而不与用户直接交互。 在从监督者那里接收到结构化任务之后，分析员接管工作流并组织一个它将遵循的待办事项列表。

paragraphs.en: Its first task is always to discover and explore the datasets in the data folder by using autonomously written Python code, in order to understand data structure, and to identify the most useful information for its current task. Then, the Analyst filters the relevant data and saves a new, significantly smaller, dataset in context , a working folder not visible to the Supervisor. To filter the dataset, the Analyst is prompted to use a specific tool, even if the structure of the data files appears simple. This logic has been chosen for the agent workflow to reduce the number of correction turns caused by improperly formatted input data, generated by autonomously written Python code, being fed into the predictive models interface.
paragraphs.zh: 它的首要任务始终是通过自主编写的 Python 代码来发现并探索数据文件夹中的数据集，以理解数据结构，并识别对其当前任务最有用的信息。 然后，分析师会筛选相关数据，并将一个规模显著更小的新数据集保存到 context（上下文）中——这是一个对监督者不可见的工作文件夹。 为了筛选数据集，系统会提示分析师使用特定的工具，即使数据文件的结构看起来很简单。 智能体工作流之所以采用这一逻辑，是为了减少由自主编写的 Python 代码生成、且格式不正确的输入数据被送入预测模型接口而导致的纠正轮次数量。

paragraphs.en: If the task concerns only basic statistical data analysis, the Analyst can access the raw dataset in the data folder and can perform computations using Python code autonomously written. paragraphs.en: Epidemiological models are dynamically imported from the models folder, jointly with information about them, such as parameters definitions, explanations on their role and the default parameter values to use when fitting. This information is useful for the Analyst to better understand the structure of a model and its applicability, before using it through the main tool for regression and forecasting. The most relevant arguments passed by the Analyst to the main forecast tool are the model name, taken from the task forwarded by the Supervisor, the initial parameter values to use for fitting, discovered by exploring the models folder, the starting date for the forecast, and the number of days to predict onwards.
paragraphs.zh: 流行病学模型从 models 文件夹中动态导入，同时导入的还有与模型相关的信息，例如参数定义、参数作用的说明，以及在拟合时使用的默认参数值。 这些信息有助于分析师（Analyst）在通过用于回归和预测的主工具使用模型之前，更好地理解模型的结构及其适用性。 分析师传递给主预测工具的最相关参数包括：模型名称（取自监督者转发的任务）、用于拟合的初始参数值（通过浏览 models 文件夹获得）、预测的起始日期，以及从该日期起要预测的天数。

paragraphs.en: fit_and_forecast : This is the main tool used to make forecasts using epidemiological models, by fitting a model to observed data and extending the simulation corresponding to the optimal set of parameters in the future, to compute the predicted incidence. Its inputs are the name of the model to use in the forecast, the path to the correctly formatted file containing the observed date, the starting date of prediction, the number of days to predict, the initial guesses for the parameters to be fitted and the fixed values for those that are kept constant. All the input values are inferred from the task given by the Supervisor, otherwise defaults are used. The output of this tool contains the predicted incidence values with the corresponding dates and the fitted values of the parameters.
paragraphs.zh: fit_and_forecast：这是使用流行病学模型进行预测的主要工具，其原理是将模型拟合到观测数据上，并把对应最优参数集的模拟延伸到未来，从而计算预测的发病率。 它的输入包括：用于预测的模型名称、指向包含观测数据的格式正确文件的路径、预测的起始日期、要预测的天数、待拟合参数的初始猜测值，以及保持不变的参数的固定值。 所有输入值均由 Supervisor 给出的任务推断得出，否则使用默认值。 该工具的输出包含带有相应日期的预测发病率数值，以及各参数的拟合值。

paragraphs.en: In order to make epidemiological simulations and predictions based on data, the Analyst sub-agent can leverage a suite of predictive models which are used by the agent as-they-are, through the fit_and_forecast and the incidence tools, without the possibility of modifying the code implementing them in any way. This design choice is one of the defining features of our framework which is motivated as follows. While at present LLMs are becoming more and more skilled at writing scientific code such as implementations of epidemiological models, delegating this task to an agent within our MAS is ill-advised as, even at T = 0 T=0 due to residual stochastic effects, the code produced by the LLM would vary across repetitions of the same query, requiring a new check of the implementation correctness and a new validation each time. By constraining the Analyst to use models written by human experts, correctness checks and validations for a given model can be performed offline once and for all, before making it available to the agent. Furthermore, this approach improves the reproducibility of the whole MAS across repeated predictions, since the model fitting pipeline implemented in the tools is fully reproducible.
paragraphs.zh: 为了进行基于数据的流行病学模拟和预测，Analyst 子智能体可以利用一套预测模型，这些模型通过 fit_and_forecast 和 incidence 工具按原样供智能体使用，且不能以任何方式修改实现这些模型的代码。 这一设计选择是我们框架的定义性特征之一，其动机如下。 尽管目前大语言模型在编写科学代码（如流行病学模型的实现）方面越来越熟练，但在我们的多智能体系统中将这一任务委托给智能体并非明智之举，因为即使温度 T=0，由于残余的随机效应，大语言模型生成的代码在重复同一查询时也会有所不同，每次都需要重新检查实现的正确性并重新进行验证。 通过约束 Analyst 使用由人类专家编写的模型，给定模型的正确性检查和验证可以在其向智能体开放之前离线一次性完成。 此外，这种方法提高了整个多智能体系统在重复预测中的可复现性，因为工具中实现的模型拟合流程是完全可复现的。

paragraphs.en: In order to keep EpidemIA as flexible as possible, the management of predictive models is entirely modular, so that new models can be added by moving Python source code files with the correct interfaces into the src/graph/tools/models folder in the MAS filesystem. These include some explanatory fields for LLM usage, default parameter values and functions to fit the model and compute the daily incidence, and are more clearly detailed in the Supplementary Information. EpidemIA comes natively with implementations of the classical SIR and SEIR epidemiological models as examples.
paragraphs.zh: 为了使 EpidemIA 尽可能保持灵活，预测模型的管理是完全模块化的，因此只需将具有正确接口的 Python 源代码文件移动到 MAS 文件系统的 src/graph/tools/models 文件夹中，即可添加新模型。 这些文件包括一些用于大语言模型使用的说明性字段、默认参数值，以及用于拟合模型和计算每日发病率的函数，其详细内容在补充信息中有更清晰的说明。 EpidemIA 原生自带经典的 SIR 和 SEIR 流行病学模型的实现作为示例。

paragraphs.en: Fitting procedures for epidemiological forecasting generally imply the minimization of some discrepancy metric between the data observed until the start of prediction and the simulated values, followed by extrapolation of the predicted values via model simulation. To leave some flexibility also in the choice of metric to minimize during fitting, a modular system analogous to that available for predictive models is implemented in the src/graph/tools/metrics folder, with specifications on the required interfaces also available in the Supplementary Information. As an example, our system contains natively the Root Mean Square Error metric.
paragraphs.zh: 流行病学预测的拟合过程通常意味着最小化预测开始前观测到的数据与模拟值之间的某种差异度量，然后通过模型模拟对预测值进行外推。 为了在拟合过程中最小化的度量的选择上也保留一定的灵活性，src/graph/tools/metrics 文件夹中实现了一个与预测模型可用的模块化系统类似的模块化系统，所需接口的规范也可在补充信息中找到。 例如，我们的系统原生包含均方根误差（Root Mean Square Error）度量。

paragraphs.en: We employed as LLM backbone for the agents an open-weight model, a design choice motivated by privacy and reproducibility requirements. Since the documents processed by the system contain sensitive information, routing them through third party inference APIs would breach data privacy regulations, on the other hand, local deployment guarantees that no data leaves the infrastructure. In addition, local serving of open-weight checkpoints removes the dependency on proprietary endpoints, whose underlying weights may be silently updated or deprecated over time, making results obtained through them difficult to reproduce.
paragraphs.zh: 我们为智能体采用了一个开放权重的模型作为 LLM 骨干，这一设计选择是出于隐私和可复现性要求的考虑。 由于系统处理的文档包含敏感信息，将其路由至第三方推理 API 会违反数据隐私法规；另一方面，本地部署可确保没有任何数据离开基础设施。 此外，在本地部署开放权重检查点消除了对专有端点的依赖，这些端点的底层权重可能会随时间被悄然更新或弃用，从而导致通过其获得的结果难以复现。

paragraphs.en: Specifically, we adopted the Qwen3.8 [ 54 , 55 ] model with 27 billions of parameters as the LLM backbone of each agent in the architecture with temperature parameter set to T = 0 T=0 in order to bring to a minimum the stochastic component inherent to autoregressive generation. paragraphs.en: In this study we presented EpidemIA, a training-free conversational MAS framework that allows non-specialized users to apply a wide variety of statistical data analysis techniques and use predictive models on hospital accesses datasets. EpidemIA facilitates the usage of data science techniques and predictive models developed by researchers in Physics and Mathematics, by working as a natural language interface. Users can perform analyses and predictions by asking questions in plain English, from which the system generates an appropriate sequence of tool calls to achieve the correct answer. After each tool call, the output is reviewed, gathering relevant insights: this information, together with the final output of the sequence, is then used to compile a comprehensive and informative report for the User. The final report is generated by the Supervisor agent and includes descriptive statistics, plots and a plain-language description of the data, analyses and the results, in order to give the User an all-round overview of the followed process and findings. In addition, our system needs neither internet access, nor uses any external LLM APIs, thus ensuring that the data never leave the hospital’s premises during processing, a basic necessary feature for the future construction of a fully privacy-compliant framework.
paragraphs.zh: 在本研究中，我们提出了 EpidemIA，这是一个免训练的对话式多智能体系统（MAS）框架，使非专业用户能够在医院就诊数据集上应用多种多样的统计分析技术并使用预测模型。 EpidemIA 通过充当自然语言接口，便利了用户使用由物理学和数学领域研究人员开发的数据科学技术与预测模型。 用户可以用通俗的英语提问来执行分析和预测，系统会根据问题生成适当的工具调用序列，从而得出正确答案。 在每次工具调用之后，系统会审查输出并收集相关洞见：这些信息连同该序列的最终输出，随后被用于为用户编写一份全面且内容丰富的报告。 最终报告由 Supervisor 智能体生成，包含描述性统计、图表以及对数据、分析和结果的通俗语言描述，以便让用户对所遵循的流程和研究发现有一个全面的了解。 此外，我们的系统既不需要互联网访问，也不使用任何外部大语言模型（LLM）API，从而确保数据在处理过程中绝不离开医院场所，这是未来构建完全符合隐私保护要求的框架的一项基本必要特性。

sents.en: In addition, our system needs neither internet access, nor uses any external LLM APIs, thus ensuring that the data never leave the hospital’s premises during processing, a basic necessary feature for the future construction of a fully privacy-compliant framework.
sents.zh: 此外，我们的系统既不需要互联网访问，也不使用任何外部大语言模型（LLM）API，从而确保数据在处理过程中绝不离开医院场所，这是未来构建完全符合隐私保护要求的框架的一项基本必要特性。

paragraphs.en: EpidemIA is a proof of concept for the integration of models and techniques developed by experts with intuitive interfaces, which does not seek to replace the Clinician, the Decision Makers or the predictive models Researcher, but aims to be a knowledge tool that allows to extract relevant information, helping them combine their effort and facilitate each other’s work. Indeed, the adoption of a system similar to the one we propose at the hospital level would provide a useful tool for Clinicians, improving their access to data and the information contained in them via analytic methods determining an improvement in their situational awareness in day to day tasks. Similarly, for Decision Makers, the informed planning of operations is dependent on activities such as data processing, prediction making and evaluation of different scenarios. These tasks, at present, require continued interaction with teams of data scientists and modelling experts, often made lengthier by terminological and methodological differences across fields, and can therefore be greatly unburdened by the adoption of an EpidemIA-like MAS, designed to bridge this gap. Moreover, a simple interface can make it easier for non-expert personnel to gain first-hand experience with the terms and concepts proper of mathematical modelling, by being able to control predictive models intuitively in a practical and familiar setting. For Researchers in Physics of Complex Systems and Mathematical Biology, on the other hand, this system offers a precious chance, thanks to its modularity, to facilitate the diffusion and field testing of the models they develop in a multitude of different settings, an often sought-after opportunity, without the direct hand-off of data which often comes with rightfully delicate privacy issues, thus determining a potential positive impact also on interdisciplinary research. In short, the positive impact of EpidemIA-like systems will be to allow mathematical modelling experts, Clinicians and Decision Makers to focus on the more important parts of their respective work, making interactions more fruitful, and less focused on the interpretative and implementation issues, without replacing the need for an increased amount of interdisciplinarity.
paragraphs.zh: EpidemIA 是一个概念验证，旨在将专家开发的模型与技术同直观的界面集成起来，它并不谋求取代临床医生、决策者或预测模型的研究者，而是希望成为一个知识工具，用于提取相关信息，帮助他们合力协作、相互促进工作。 事实上，在医院层面采用一个类似于我们所提出方案的系统，将为临床医生提供一个有用的工具，通过分析方法改善他们对数据及其中所含信息的获取，从而提升他们在日常工作中的态势感知能力。 同样，对决策者而言，有据可依的行动规划依赖于数据处理、预测生成以及不同情景评估等活动。 这些任务目前需要与数据科学家和建模专家团队持续互动，而不同领域之间的术语和方法差异往往使这一过程更加冗长，因此，采用类似 EpidemIA 的多智能体系统（MAS）——其设计初衷正是弥合这一鸿沟——将极大地减轻这些负担。 此外，一个简单的界面可以让非专业人员在一个实用且熟悉的环境中直观地操控预测模型，从而更容易地亲身接触数学建模所特有的术语与概念。 另一方面，对于复杂系统物理学和数学生物学领域的研究者来说，得益于其模块化设计，该系统提供了一个宝贵的机会，便于他们将所开发的模型在众多不同场景中进行推广和实地测试——这是一个经常被期待的机会，且无需直接移交数据（直接移交往往涉及十分敏感的隐私问题），从而对跨学科研究也产生潜在的积极影响。 简而言之，类 EpidemIA 系统的积极影响在于，让数学建模专家、临床医生和决策者能够专注于各自工作中更重要的部分，使互动更富有成效，并减少对解释和实现问题的关注，同时并不取代对加强跨学科合作的需要。

paragraphs.en: The main limitation in our study is related to the evaluation of our system as a whole. Indeed, the single predictive models validation can be easily performed via standard methods, such as sensitivity analysis, and can be done entirely offline with respect to MAS integration. Similarly, the open-weights LLMs available for local running, and thus employable as backbones in our system, are often widely tested on standardized benchmarks upon release. The evaluation of the whole system, on the other hand, presents several points which must be treated attentively. The main reason for this, is that reproducible testing of a system such as EpidemIA is easily attainable only with a publicly available underlying dataset, which is not the case at present for the data we have used during the framework construction. In addition to this, devising a protocol for the procedural generation of question-answer pairs in a dataset and predictive model-agnostic way is a challenge in itself, while compiling such a dataset by hand is a highly time-consuming process, and most importantly data and model dependent.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究的主要局限性与对整个系统的评估有关。 事实上，单个预测模型的验证可以通过标准方法轻松完成，例如敏感性分析，并且可以完全在离线状态下独立于MAS集成进行。 类似地，可用于本地运行的开源权重LLM（因而可作为我们系统的骨干模型）在发布时通常已经在标准化基准上得到了广泛测试。 另一方面，对整个系统的评估则涉及若干必须认真对待的问题。 其主要原因在于，像EpidemIA这样的系统，其可复现测试只有在底层数据集公开可得时才容易实现，而我们在构建框架时所使用的数据目前并非如此。 除此之外，设计一种以程序化方式生成问答对的协议，使其既独立于数据集又独立于预测模型，这本身就是一项挑战；而手工编制这样的数据集则极其耗时，且最重要的是依赖于具体数据和模型。

paragraphs.en: While the current modular structure through which the EpidemIA framework manages complex models, one natural evolution of our work is to extend its predictive capabilities beyond epidemiological events. For example, the framework could integrate environmental and climatological data sources, informing predictive models for health hazard due to extreme weather events such as heatwaves. These could simply be added as new tools for the Analyst, or by developing specific agents in the MAS architecture, which is by design scalable to several subagents managed by the Supervisor. Incorporating such predictive models would give emergency department Decision Makers crucial lead time to optimize staff allocation and clinical bed capacity.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然 EpidemIA 框架目前通过模块化结构来管理复杂模型，但我们工作的一个自然演进方向是将它的预测能力扩展到流行病学事件之外。 例如，该框架可以整合环境与气候数据源，为极端天气事件（如热浪）造成的健康危害提供预测模型。 这些功能既可以简单地作为分析师的新工具加入，也可以通过在多智能体系统（MAS）架构中开发专门的智能体来实现，该架构在设计上可扩展为由主管管理的多个子智能体。 引入这类预测模型将使急诊科决策者获得关键的提前时间，以优化人员配置和临床床位容量。

paragraphs.en: In parallel, expanding the capabilities of the existing agentic architecture represents another improvement. This could be done in several ways. A first one would be to replace the underlying model powering EpidemIA. As a matter of fact, let us stress again how EpidemIA is, by design, model agnostic. Therefore, if an end User has access to a more powerful machine than the one we employed, they could run the same exact MAS system powered by a much smarter LLM backbone. That would constitute, without any doubt, an instantaneous leap in the quality of the output.
paragraphs.zh: 与此同时，扩展现有智能体架构的能力是另一项改进方向。 这可以通过多种方式实现。 第一种方式是替换驱动 EpidemIA 的底层模型。 事实上，让我们再次强调，EpidemIA 在设计上是模型无关的。 因此，如果最终用户拥有比我们所使用的更强大的机器，他们可以运行完全相同的多智能体系统，但由更智能的大语言模型骨干驱动。 这无疑将使输出质量实现即时跃升。

paragraphs.zh: 与此同时，扩大 LLM 主干的规模可能根本就没有必要：近来，开源 LLM 进步迅速，经常能够追平甚至超越 6 到 12 个月前发布的领先专有系统的性能。 我们所采用的主干 Qwen3.8:27B，在智能水平上必将在未来几个月内被同等规模范围的新模型所超越。

paragraphs.en: Another option, and a natural extension of the MAS capabilities, would be to integrate specialized agents that can write SQL queries in order to work directly on large scale databases, or, alternatively, provide the Analyst agent with tools to perform these operations. Equipping agents with advanced Text-to-SQL generation would enable automated extraction and aggregation from clinical information systems. Interacting natively with large scale relational hospital databases removes intermediate abstraction layers, scales efficiently with massive data volumes, and allows clinical decision support systems to operate on live, institutional level data streams. Larger scale hospital-level implementations of our framework should also take further steps to ensure full compliance with privacy regulations, together with clinical data preservation. This could be achieved e.g. via local sandboxing and security checks on code written and executed by the agents. Provided that these requirements are met, systems like EpidemIA could become useful also as smart interfaces for the access to disaggregated personal data, by processing it on demand and providing aggregated representations to the user.
paragraphs.zh: 另一个选项，也是对多智能体系统能力的自然延伸，是集成能够编写 SQL 查询的专门智能体，从而直接在大规模数据库上操作，或者为分析员智能体提供执行这些操作的工具。 为智能体配备先进的文本到 SQL 生成能力，将能够从临床信息系统中自动进行数据提取和聚合。 与大规模关系型医院数据库进行原生交互，可以去除中间抽象层，在海量数据规模下高效扩展，并使临床决策支持系统能够在实时的机构级数据流上运行。 在更大规模的医院层面实施我们的框架时，还应采取进一步措施，确保完全符合隐私法规，并同时做好临床数据保存。 这可以例如通过对智能体编写和执行的代码进行本地沙箱隔离和安全检查来实现。 只要满足这些要求，像 EpidemIA 这样的系统还可以作为访问非聚合个人数据的智能接口，通过按需处理数据并向用户提供聚合化的呈现。

paragraphs.en: Finally, to tackle the issue of evaluating EpidemIA in a significant way, the LLM-as-a-judge technique [ 58 , 59 ] appears as the most promising way to proceed, provided that a sufficiently practical way to generate procedurally question-answer pairs, is available, likely including the use of independent LLM instances to handle generic data formats.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，为了以有意义的方式评估 EpidemIA，LLM-as-a-judge（以大语言模型作为评判者）技术 [ 58 , 59 ] 看来是最有前景的可行途径，前提是有一种足够实用的方法来程序化地生成问答对，这可能包括使用独立的 LLM 实例来处理通用数据格式。
